title: The 8 Best Epoxy Glue for Wood 2026
h1: The 8 Best Epoxy Glue for Wood 2026
metaDescription: Our 8 picks for epoxy glue for wood 2026, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at epoxy glue for wood 2026 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Gorilla 2 Part Epoxy, 5 Minute Set, .85 oz Syringe
products.blurb: Key specs: 5-minute open time, 24-hour full cure, Dual-syringe mixing prevents contamination.
strengths: Dual syringe dispenses equal parts without measuring, prevents ratio errors
5-minute open time is long enough for most small repairs and short assemblies
Fills gaps that PVA glue cannot bridge, good for rough or uneven joint surfaces
Available at most hardware stores, convenient restock
limitations: 5-minute open time too short for complex multi-joint assemblies
Syringe does not reseal well, remaining epoxy may cure in the tip
products.bestFor: buyers who want the best overall package

products.name: System Three T-88 Structural Epoxy Adhesive, 1 Pt Bottle
products.blurb: Key specs: Marine-grade waterproof formula, High-performance structural bonding, Long working time.
strengths: Marine-grade waterproofing, trusted in boat building, superior to most wood epoxies
Formulated for superior results under adverse and wet-bonding conditions
Long open time gives ample working time for complex assemblies
Cures to a rigid, sandable, paintable surface, suitable for exterior applications
limitations: Higher price than consumer epoxy syringes
Requires separate measuring of resin and hardener, more complex than pre-metered syringes
features: Sands and paints cleanly when cured

products.name: J-B Weld 8257 KwikWood Wood Repair Epoxy Putty Stick, 1 oz
products.blurb: Key specs: 15-25 minute set time, 900 PSI strength, Hand-moldable putty stick.
strengths: Hand-kneadable putty format makes it easy to pack into gaps, holes, and rot damage
15-25 minute working time gives more working room than 5-minute alternatives
Cures to a paintable, sandable, drillable surface that will not shrink or rot
Available at automotive and hardware stores widely
limitations: Cured color is light tan, visible in light-colored wood if not painted or stained
Harder to sand than West System when fully cured

products.name: PC Products PC-Woody Wood Repair Epoxy Paste, 1.5 oz Two-Part (Pack of 12)
products.blurb: Key specs: Paste consistency, stays in place, Accepts nails and screws when cured, Sandable, stainable, paintable.
strengths: Paste consistency stays in fills without sagging, ideal for overhead or vertical repairs
Accepts nails and screws after cure, treated as structural wood, not just filler
Stains similarly to wood, less visible in natural finish applications than standard epoxy
Excellent adhesion to degraded and rotted wood, the standard for exterior wood repair
limitations: Shorter pot life than West System, must work quickly once mixed
Paste format not suitable for gap-filling between tight-fitting joinery
features: Accepts nails and screws when cured
Excellent adhesion to soft or rotted wood

products.name: Loctite Epoxy Marine, 0.85 fl oz Syringe (Pack of 2)
products.blurb: Key specs: Marine waterproof formula, Dual-syringe dispensing, Bonds wet surfaces.
strengths: Marine-grade waterproofing in an accessible dual-syringe format
Bonds wet surfaces, useful for below-waterline and damp exterior repairs
3,000 PSI bond strength once cured
Loctite brand consistency and availability
limitations: Less penetrating than a dedicated low-viscosity structural epoxy, not ideal for wood stabilization
2-hour set time is slower than 5-minute consumer epoxies

products.name: Loctite Epoxy Extra Time, 0.85 fl oz Syringe, 60 Minute
products.blurb: Key specs: 60-minute set time, Translucent yellow cure, 3,000 PSI bond strength.
strengths: 60-minute set time for complex assemblies that require extended positioning time
More time to align parts before the epoxy sets compared to 5-minute formulas
3,000 PSI final bond strength, exceeds most consumer epoxies
Dual syringe dispenses equal parts without measuring
limitations: Long open time means longer clamp time than 5-minute epoxies, slower workflow
Translucent yellow cure is more visible than a fully clear epoxy

products.name: System Three Mirror Coat BarTop Epoxy Resin Coating, 1.5 Gallon
products.blurb: Key specs: Crystal clear cure, UV stabilized formula, Low blush in humid conditions.
strengths: Crystal-clear cure reveals wood grain beneath, suitable for river tables and decorative fills
UV stabilizer resists yellowing in indirect sunlight
Low blush formulation stays clear in shop humidity, most epoxies develop a white haze
Self-leveling reduces brush marks and lays flat without manipulation
limitations: Not a high-strength structural epoxy, intended for coating and filling, not load-bearing joints

products.name: Devcon 23145 2 Ton Flow-Mix Epoxy, 14 mL Self-Mixing Applicator
products.blurb: Key specs: Self-mixing flow applicator, 30-minute open time, No mix, no mess dispensing.
strengths: Self-mixing applicator dispenses pre-ratioed epoxy with no measuring or mixing mess
Devcon brand trust, long-established industrial epoxy manufacturer
Precision applicator nozzle allows controlled application for small repairs
Bonds to wood, metal, ceramic, and glass, good for mixed-material repairs
limitations: 30-minute open time is slower than 5-minute epoxies, not ideal for quick fixes
Applicator format costs more per repair than a basic twin-tube
features: Works on wood, metal, ceramic, glass
